## Transcript {.i-book-open}

Chat transcripts are well-rendered with high-quality interface. Agent tool calls are stacked to release reading pressure. You can expand them and even get summaries of each tool call to understand what happened. Artifacts, background jobs, subagents, Q&A sessions are all properly taken care of with smooth UI.

## Composer {.i-inbox}

Attach files by pasting, dropping, or the [+]{.kbd} button. **`@`** picks a file or folder from the project, and **`/`** lists the agent's slash commands and skills. Spelling and grammar are checked as you type.

::: {.note}
We proudly recommend using [Kotoba](https://github.com/alkaline-software/kotoba) as your dictation app on Emaki or any other composer on your machine. It supports light-weighted models for voice-to-text dictation and post-processing.
:::

## Mode, model and effort {.i-sparkles}

By providing three pills under the composer, Emaki made it easy to toggle among different modes, models, and efforts without needing to trigger keyboard commands or **`/`** commands (though they are also supported).

::: {.layout .layout-page}
::: {.fig data-figure="composer-pills" aria-label="The foot of Emaki's composer, close up: the plus, the mode pill reading Auto mode in amber, the effort pill reading High effort in the accent, the model pill reading Opus 5.5, and send. A pill under the pointer opens its list over it, each choice in its color with a line on what it does and the current one ticked, and a row under the pointer puts its value on the pill."}
:::
:::

## Status line {.i-gauge}

The row under the composer shows how much of the context window is used
and where the 5-hour and 7-day limits stand. Its colors change according to
the thresholds. The status line logic is from the [Waza](https://github.com/tw93/waza) plugin by [tw93](https://github.com/tw93).

::: {.layout .layout-page}
::: {.fig data-figure="composer-status" aria-label="The status line under Emaki's composer, close up: Context 38% in green, 5h: 34% with 2h41m left in blue, 7d: 12% with 5d1h left in blue. A part under the pointer stands forward and shows a higher number in the color it takes there."}
:::
:::
